purpose: One bounded architecture diagnostic: test whether explicit predicted argument spans with gold-event-conditioned role/link scoring improves native MailEx argument structure over the compact BIO model.

scope.diagnostic_type: gold-type-and-gold-trigger-conditioned oracle structural diagnostic; not an end-to-end event detector and not the final FYP model

span_preflight.evaluation_policy: score all native gold argument records; candidate misses remain false negatives

architecture.family: one fine-tuned shared DistilBERT encoder with explicit contiguous-span proposal and shared event-conditioned multi-label argument-link scoring
heads: independent token start and end boundary logits
span representation from start, end, and mean token vectors with a learned span-presence score
event-conditioned multi-label link scorer over the TRAIN-derived native (role, exact-case qualifier) inventory
architecture.conditioning: At DEV, supply each native gold event type and trigger embedding to isolate argument span and event-link quality. Event IDs are carried only as output alignment keys and are not model features.
architecture.native_contract: Retain case-sensitive native event types, role labels, qualifiers, event IDs, and half-open character offsets. A predicted span may link to more than one gold event. No source-text repair or offset relocation.

preprocessing.tokenizer: local tokenizer matching the pinned DistilBERT revision
preprocessing.coverage: overlapping windows must represent every nonempty source token; fail closed on any unrepresented token
preprocessing.zero_width_tokens: exclude only from model view; keep source text and native offsets unchanged
preprocessing.span_offsets: map predicted token boundaries directly to original half-open character offsets
preprocessing.role_inventory: all exact (role, qualifier-or-empty-string) keys observed in TRAIN; no case folding or qualifier normalization beyond null to empty string
preprocessing.source_annotations: Do not change native source flags, labels, or BIO conversion.

training.negative_sampling: gold argument spans plus deterministic seed-and-epoch sampled non-gold contiguous spans; all native gold events in the message participate in link supervision; no DEV gold spans are injected at inference
training.checkpoint_selection: highest DEV gold-type-and-gold-trigger argument role exact micro F1 at the fixed 0.5 link threshold; earliest epoch wins ties
training.message_order: shuffle TRAIN rows with Python random seed = run seed + epoch index; no sampler tuning

metrics.success_rule: mean primary F1 >= 0.50 across all three completed seeds AND mean secondary linked partial-record F1 >= 0.711 across the same three seeds
metrics.summary: Report all seed scores, mean, and sample standard deviation. No seed omission or post-hoc threshold selection. Use the existing native evaluator with the complete DEV gold rows so unproposed spans count as missed arguments.

runtime_guard.timing_includes: tokenization, overlapping-window creation, encoder inference, candidate generation, and event-conditioned role scoring for one message
runtime_guard.fixed_dev_examples: first DEV row in file order with 39 native tokens; first DEV row at the maximum native-token length (721)
runtime_guard.latency_repetitions: For each example, perform 3 warmups; measure the 39-token case 25 times and report its median; measure the 721-token case 5 times and report its median.
runtime_guard.pretraining_gate: Measure the initialized architecture on the fixed DEV messages before the first optimizer step. Abort all training if any runtime or weight-size guard fails.
runtime_guard.per_seed_gate: Apply the same CPU latency and actual saved-weight-size limits to each selected checkpoint before starting the next seed. A failure terminates the diagnostic.

compute_budget.guard_policy: Check the deadline and CUDA reserved memory during training batches and before each epoch. If all three seeds are not completed within the fixed budget, report INCOMPLETE; do not reduce the seed count or epoch limit and do not launch a variant.

decision_and_audit.miss_rule: If the preregistered success rule is missed, stop this architecture cycle.
decision_and_audit.error_analysis: One source-bearing DEV review pass after the frozen three-seed run, with only source-free aggregate findings in the public report.
decision_and_audit.private_outputs: Store checkpoints, prediction JSONL, histories with case IDs, and source-bearing error samples under a fresh ignored run directory. Never add email text or message IDs to tracked files.
decision_and_audit.comparison_limit: This oracle diagnostic evaluates argument representation and event linking under gold type/trigger conditioning. It does not establish end-to-end extraction quality or FYP-domain effectiveness.
